initial_sweep.factor_base_dimensions: floor(log2(subgroup_order)/m) plus offsets -2,-1,0,1,2 where valid; freeze exact resulting sizes

invariants: No planted scalar or point witness is given to a solver.
All comparisons use identical targets and permitted decompositions.
Timeout and OOM are never UNSAT or silently dropped.
All counters identify their unit; missing counters are null, never zero.
Do not add a solver sub-timer to its enclosing solver timer.
A Boolean-system root is not yet a group relation.
Negation and Frobenius compression are recorded separately from raw base support.
Frobenius images are not automatically independent relation rows.
The relation matrix is over the subgroup scalar field, even for characteristic-two curves.
First-solution and enumeration results have separate leaderboards.
Fixed setup is charged once; warm amortization always names the target count.
Full-rank recovery and final scalar verification are required for full-ECDLP claims.
Repeated summands and exceptional partial sums must have matching coverage across encodings.
A degree-of-regularity estimate is not inferred from first fall degree.

promotion_gate.criterion: At least 20 percent reduction in paired common operations per fresh verified relation at fixed support and m, with calibrated conversions and all failed-attempt costs; this is an engineering gate, not evidence of an advance.
additional_requirements: at least three independent curves and two adjacent parameter cells
95 percent paired bootstrap interval excludes no improvement
holdout targets and at least one holdout curve
rho comparison uses the same resource envelope
full-attack operation estimate decreases with all phases priced
report ratios to both the applicable derived floor and measured matched reference
all final scalar recoveries verify before a complete ECDLP claim
promotion_gate.note: This is an engineering acceptance threshold, not a complexity theorem.
abandon_or_reclassify: No gate improvement on holdout cells: stop expanding this variant.
Total cost rises despite a smaller solver counter: classify as relabelling.
Missing phase costs or conversions: retain accounting status; do not promote.
A verified counterexample invalidates the run regardless of speed.

comparison_contract.normalization: S = total common operations / sqrt(N), where N is the subgroup order, not the field degree n
comparison_contract.conversion: Measure common-unit conversion on the same field, representation and implementation; never convert SAT conflicts with a guessed factor or reuse the F_p^3 conversion for binary fields.
comparison_contract.unknown: Unpriced phases, conversions, subgroup orders and ratios are null, never zero.
comparison_contract.count_floor: For independent uniform targets with at most one row per attempt, expected attempts >= R_req / min(1, binom(M+m-1,m)/N). This bounds attempt counts, not the runtime of every coordinate algorithm.
comparison_contract.rho: Measure the eligible automorphism-aware rho reference on the same subgroup and operation unit before reporting a full-attack ratio.
comparison_contract.admission: All phases must be priced and final scalar verified before admitting a full-DLP S. Polynomial-instance timing alone is not admitted.
comparison_contract.exponents: At least four sizes and the whole method; no exponent fit to this selected three-size pilot.
